title.zh: 卷三百九十七 列傳第一百五十六 徐誼 吳獵 項安世 薛叔似 劉甲 楊輔 劉光祖
title.en: Volume 397 Biographies 156: Xu Yi, Wu Lie, Xiang Anshi, Xue Shusi, Liu Jia, Yang Fu, Liu Guangzu
title.raw: 卷三百九十七 列傳第一百五十六 徐誼 吳獵 項安世 薛叔似 劉甲 楊輔 劉光祖 Volume 397 Biographies 156: Xu Yi, Wu Lie, Xiang Anshi, Xue Shusi, Liu Jia, Yang Fu, Liu Guangzu

sentences.zh: 徐誼，字子宜，一字宏父，溫州人。

translations.literal: Xu Yi, style name Ziyi, also styled Hongfu, was a man of Wenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Yi, whose style name was Ziyi and who was also known as Hongfu, came from Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 乾道八年進士，累官太常丞。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Qiandao he became a jinshi, and through successive offices rose to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the eighth year of the Qiandao reign and eventually rose to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 孝宗臨御久，事皆上決，執政惟奉旨而行，群下多恐懼顧望。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaozong had long held the throne; all affairs were decided by him above, and the chief ministers only carried out his orders, while many below were fearful and hesitant.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaozong had reigned for a long time, and he decided everything himself; the chief ministers merely executed his orders, while many officials below were fearful and held back.

sentences.zh: 誼諫曰：「若是則人主日聖，人臣日愚，陛下誰與共功名乎？」

translations.literal: Yi remonstrated, saying: "If it is thus, the sovereign grows daily in sagacity and the ministers daily in foolishness—Your Majesty, with whom will you share achievement and fame?"
translations.idiomatic: Yi remonstrated: "If things go on this way, the ruler grows wiser by the day and his ministers more foolish—Your Majesty, with whom will you share glory?"

sentences.zh: 及論樂制，誼對以「宮亂則荒，其君驕；

translations.literal: When music regulations were discussed, Yi replied with the saying "When the gong mode is disordered, there is waste and the ruler grows arrogant;
translations.idiomatic: Later, when court music was under discussion, he answered with the classic line: "When the gong mode falls into disorder, the state grows wasteful and the ruler arrogant;

sentences.zh: 商亂則陂，其臣壞。」

translations.literal: when the shang mode is disordered, there is decline and the ministers are ruined."
translations.idiomatic: when the shang mode falls into disorder, the state declines and the ministers are ruined."

sentences.zh: 上遽改容曰：「卿可謂不以官自惰矣。」

translations.literal: The emperor at once changed expression and said: "You may be said not to grow idle in your office."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor immediately changed his expression and said, "You may truly be said not to grow idle in your office."

sentences.zh: 知徽州，陛辭，屬光宗初受禪，誼奏：「三代聖王，有至誠而無權術，至誠不息，則可以達天德矣。」

translations.literal: As prefect of Huizhou, on taking leave at court—this was when Emperor Guangzong had just received the abdication—Yi memorialized: "The sage kings of the Three Dynasties had utmost sincerity and no stratagems; with sincerity unceasing, one may reach Heaven's virtue."
translations.idiomatic: When he was appointed prefect of Huizhou and took leave at court—just as Emperor Guangzong had received the throne—Yi memorialized: "The sage kings of the Three Dynasties possessed utmost sincerity and no stratagems; with sincerity never ceasing, one may attain Heaven's virtue."

sentences.zh: 至郡，歙縣有妻殺夫繫獄，以五歲女為證，誼疑曰：「婦人能一掌致人死乎？」

translations.literal: On reaching the prefecture, in She County a wife who had killed her husband was imprisoned, with a five-year-old daughter as witness; Yi doubted and said: "Can a woman kill a man with one blow of the palm?"
translations.idiomatic: Once in office, in She County a wife accused of killing her husband was held in prison, with her five-year-old daughter as witness. Yi voiced his doubt: "Can a woman kill a man with a single slap?"

sentences.zh: 緩之未覆也。

translations.literal: He delayed the case and had not yet reviewed it.
translations.idiomatic: He stayed the case and had not yet rendered judgment.

sentences.zh: 會郡究實稅於庭，死者父母及弟在焉，乃言：「我子欠租久繫，饑而大叫，役者批之，墮水死矣。」

translations.literal: When the prefecture was verifying tax arrears in court, the dead man's parents and younger brother were present and then spoke: "Our son owed rent and had long been detained; in hunger he cried out loudly, and the runners struck him—he fell into the water and died."
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, while the prefecture was verifying tax arrears in open court, the victim's parents and younger brother were present and spoke up: "Our son owed rent and had long been detained; starving, he cried out, and the runners beat him until he fell into the water and drowned."

sentences.zh: 然後冤者得釋，吏皆坐罪，闔郡以為神。

translations.literal: Only then were the wrongfully accused released, the clerks all punished, and the whole prefecture regarded him as divine.
translations.idiomatic: Only then was the innocent party released, the clerks were all punished, and the whole prefecture regarded him as uncannily just.

sentences.zh: 移提舉浙西常平，守右司郎中，遷左司。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Intendant of Ever-Normal Granaries in western Zhejiang, held the post of Right Bureau Director in the Secretariat, and was promoted to Left Bureau Director.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to serve as Intendant of Ever-Normal Granaries in western Zhejiang, held the post of Right Bureau Director in the Secretariat, and was promoted to Left Bureau Director.

sentences.zh: 孝宗疾浸棘，上久稽定省，誼入諫，退告宰相曰：「上慰納從容，然目瞪不瞬，意思恍惚，真疾也。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaozong's illness grew steadily worse; the emperor long delayed his visits of inquiry, and Yi entered to remonstrate; on retiring he told the chief minister: "The emperor received me with ease, yet his eyes stared without blinking and his mind was dazed—this is truly illness.
translations.idiomatic: As Emperor Xiaozong's illness worsened, the reigning emperor long delayed his visits of filial inquiry. Yi remonstrated at court and afterward told the chief minister: "The emperor received me calmly, yet his eyes stared without blinking and his mind seemed dazed—this is a real illness.

sentences.zh: 宜禱祠郊廟，進皇子嘉王參決。」

translations.literal: One should offer prayers at the suburban altars and temples and advance the Prince of Jia to share in decisions."
translations.idiomatic: He urged prayers at the suburban altars and temples and that the Prince of Jia be advanced to share in government decisions."

sentences.zh: 丞相留正不克用。

translations.literal: Chief Minister Liu Zheng could not carry this out.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Minister Liu Zheng could not put this into effect.

sentences.zh: 孝宗崩，上不能喪，祭奠有祝，有司不敢攝，百官皆未成服。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xiaozong died, the emperor could not observe mourning; at the sacrificial rites there were prayers, but the officials dared not take charge, and none of the hundred officials had yet put on mourning dress.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaozong died, the reigning emperor could not properly observe mourning; sacrificial rites required prayers, but the responsible offices dared not take charge, and none of the officials had yet donned mourning garb.

sentences.zh: 誼與少保吳琚議請太皇太后臨朝，扶嘉王代祭。

translations.literal: Yi and Junior Guardian Wu Ju discussed asking the Grand Empress Dowager to preside at court and supporting the Prince of Jia to perform the sacrifices in his stead.
translations.idiomatic: Yi and Junior Guardian Wu Ju proposed that the Grand Empress Dowager preside at court and that the Prince of Jia be supported to perform the sacrifices in the emperor's place.

sentences.zh: 及將禫，正憂懼，仆於殿庭而去。

translations.literal: When the end of mourning was near, Zheng was anxious and fearful and collapsed in the palace courtyard and left.
translations.idiomatic: As the end of mourning approached, Liu Zheng, anxious and fearful, collapsed in the palace courtyard and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 誼以書譙趙汝愚曰：「自古人臣為忠則忠，為姦則姦，忠姦雜而能濟者，未之有也。

translations.literal: Yi wrote in reproach to Zhao Ruoyu: "Since antiquity, when a minister was loyal he was loyal, and when treacherous he was treacherous—there has never been one who mixed loyalty and treachery and yet succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: Yi wrote to rebuke Zhao Ruoyu: "Since antiquity, ministers who were loyal were wholly loyal and those who were treacherous wholly treacherous—never has anyone mixed the two and still succeeded.

sentences.zh: 公內雖心惕，外欲坐觀，非雜之謂歟？

translations.literal: Within you are fearful at heart, yet outwardly you wish to sit and watch—is this not what is meant by mixing?
translations.idiomatic: Within you are fearful, yet outwardly you wish only to watch from the sidelines—is that not precisely such a mixture?

sentences.zh: 國家安危，在此一舉。」

translations.literal: The safety or peril of the state hangs on this one move."
translations.idiomatic: The safety of the state hangs on this single move."

sentences.zh: 汝愚問策安出，誼曰：「此大事，非憲聖太后命不可。

translations.literal: Ruoyu asked where the plan should come from; Yi said: "This is a great affair—it cannot be done without an order from Empress Dowager Xiansheng.
translations.idiomatic: When Ruoyu asked where a plan should come from, Yi said, "This is a momentous affair—it cannot proceed without an order from Empress Dowager Xiansheng.

sentences.zh: 而知閤門事韓侂胄，憲聖之戚也，同里蔡必勝與侂胄同在閤門，可因必勝招之。」

translations.literal: Han Tuozhou, who knew affairs of the Gatehouse, was a kinsman of Xiansheng; Cai Bisheng of the same district served with Tuozhou in the Gatehouse—through Bisheng one may summon him."
translations.idiomatic: Han Tuozhou, who handled Gatehouse affairs, was a kinsman of the empress dowager; Cai Bisheng, a fellow townsman serving with Tuozhou in the Gatehouse, could be used to summon him."

sentences.zh: 侂胄至，汝愚以內禪議遣侂胄請於憲聖，侂胄因內侍張宗尹、關禮達汝愚意，憲聖許之。

translations.literal: When Tuozhou arrived, Ruoyou sent him with the plan for an inner abdication to request it of Xiansheng; Tuozhou through the inner attendants Zhang Zongyin and Guan Li conveyed Ruoyou's intent, and Xiansheng assented.
translations.idiomatic: When Tuozhou arrived, Ruoyu sent him to present the plan for an inner abdication to the empress dowager; through the inner attendants Zhang Zongyin and Guan Li, Tuozhou conveyed Ruoyu's intent, and she gave her assent.

sentences.zh: 寧宗即位，誼遷檢正中書門下諸房公事兼權刑部侍郎，進權工部侍郎、知臨安府。

translations.literal: When Emperor Ningzong took the throne, Yi was transferred to Revising Secretary for the various bureaus of the Secretariat-Chancellery and concurrently Acting Vice Minister of Justice, then advanced to Acting Vice Minister of Works and prefect of Lin'an.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Ningzong ascended the throne, Yi was made Revising Secretary for the Secretariat-Chancellery bureaus and concurrently Acting Vice Minister of Justice, then promoted to Acting Vice Minister of Works and prefect of Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 侂胄恃功，以賞薄浸觖望。

translations.literal: Tuozhou relied on his merit; because rewards were meager he gradually grew resentful.
translations.idiomatic: Tuozhou, relying on his services, grew increasingly resentful as his rewards proved meager.

sentences.zh: 誼告汝愚曰：「異時必為國患，宜飽其欲而遠之。」

translations.literal: Yi told Ruoyu: "In time he will surely become a peril to the state; one should satisfy his desires and keep him at a distance."
translations.idiomatic: Yi warned Ruoyu: "In time he will surely become a danger to the state; satisfy his desires and keep him at a distance."

sentences.zh: 不聽。

translations.literal: Ruoyu would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: Ruoyu would not heed him.

sentences.zh: 汝愚雅器誼，除授建明多咨訪，誼隨事裨助，不避形跡，怨者始眾。

translations.literal: Ruoyu greatly valued Yi; in appointments and policies he often consulted him, and Yi assisted in every matter without avoiding open involvement, so those who resented him began to multiply.
translations.idiomatic: Ruoyu held Yi in high regard and often consulted him on appointments and policy; Yi assisted in every matter without concealing his involvement, and resentful enemies began to multiply.

sentences.zh: 嘗勸汝愚早退，汝愚亦自請：「名在屬籍，不宜久司揆事，願因阜陵訖事以去。」

translations.literal: He once urged Ruoyu to retire early; Ruoyu also requested on his own: "My name is on the imperial clan register—I should not long manage the chief ministership; I wish to withdraw once affairs for the late emperor's tomb are finished."
translations.idiomatic: He once urged Ruoyu to retire early; Ruoyu himself also requested: "As one listed in the imperial clan register, I ought not long to hold the chief ministership; I wish to withdraw once the late emperor's burial affairs are concluded."

sentences.zh: 寧宗已許之。

translations.literal: Emperor Ningzong had already granted this.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ningzong had already agreed.

sentences.zh: 侂胄出入禁中無度，誼密啟汝愚，無計防之，乃直面諷侂胄。

translations.literal: Tuozhou entered and left the inner palace without restraint; Yi secretly informed Ruoyu, but with no means to guard against him, he then confronted Tuozhou face to face with satire.
translations.idiomatic: Tuozhou came and went within the inner palace without restraint. Yi secretly informed Ruoyu, but finding no way to check him, finally confronted Tuozhou directly with pointed satire.

sentences.zh: 侂胄疑將排己，首謁誼，退束裝，冀誼還謁，留之通殷勤，誼不往。

translations.literal: Tuozhou suspected he was to be removed and first called on Yi; on returning he packed his belongings, hoping Yi would call on him in return and detain him with cordial words—Yi did not go.
translations.idiomatic: Tuozhou, suspecting he was about to be pushed out, paid Yi the first visit; on returning he packed his bags, hoping Yi would call on him in return and keep him with cordial words—Yi did not go.

sentences.zh: 吏部侍郎彭龜年論侂胄罪狀，侂胄疑汝愚、誼知其情，益怨恨。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Personnel Peng Guinian impeached Tuozhou's crimes; Tuozhou suspected that Ruoyu and Yi knew his situation and hated them all the more.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister of Personnel Peng Guinian denounced Tuozhou's offenses; Tuozhou suspected that Ruoyu and Yi knew his situation and hated them all the more.

sentences.zh: 以御史劉德秀、胡纮疏誼，責惠州團練副使、南安軍安置，移袁州，又移婺州。

translations.literal: Through the censors Liu Dexiu and Hu Hong memorializing against Yi, he was demoted to Deputy Military Commissioner of Huizhou and assigned to Nan'an, then transferred to Yuanzhou and again to Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Through memorials by censors Liu Dexiu and Hu Hong, Yi was demoted to Deputy Military Commissioner of Huizhou and assigned to Nan'an, then transferred to Yuanzhou and later to Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 久之，許自便。

translations.literal: After a long while he was permitted to move freely.
translations.idiomatic: After a long while he was permitted to return to private life.

sentences.zh: 復官，提舉崇道觀，起守江州，加集英殿修撰，升寶謨閣待制，移知建康府，兼江淮制置使。

translations.literal: His office was restored; he was made intendant of the Chongdao Abbey, then recalled to govern Jiangzhou, added as Compiler at the Hall for Gathering Excellence, promoted to Attendant Gentleman at the Baomo Pavilion, transferred as prefect of Jiankang, and concurrently Commissioner for the Huai and Yang regions.
translations.idiomatic: His office was restored; he was made intendant of the Chongdao Abbey, then recalled to govern Jiangzhou, made Compiler at the Hall for Gathering Excellence, promoted to Attendant Gentleman at the Baomo Pavilion, transferred to Jiankang as prefect, and concurrently made Commissioner for the Huai and Yang regions.

sentences.zh: 初，金攻廬、楚不下，留兵綴濠州以待和，時時鈔掠，與宋師遇，殺傷相當，淮人大驚，復迸流江南，在建康者以數十萬計。

translations.literal: At first the Jin attacked Lu and Chu but could not take them; they left troops to pin Hao Prefecture while awaiting peace, and from time to time raided; when they met Song forces casualties were about equal; people of the Huai were greatly alarmed and again surged south across the Yangtze—those in Jiankang numbered in the hundreds of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the Jin had attacked Lu and Chu without success, left troops to hold Hao Prefecture while awaiting peace talks, and from time to time raided; when they met Song forces casualties were roughly equal. People along the Huai were terrified and again fled south across the Yangtze—refugees in Jiankang numbered in the hundreds of thousands.

sentences.zh: 誼晝夜拊循，益嚴備禦，請專捍敵，勿從中御。

translations.literal: Yi day and night comforted and reassured them, tightened defenses all the more, and requested sole authority to repel the enemy without interference from the center.
translations.idiomatic: Yi comforted the people day and night, tightened defenses, and asked that he be left to repel the enemy without interference from the court.

sentences.zh: 朝廷懼生事，移知隆興府以卒。

translations.literal: The court, fearing trouble, transferred him to Longxing Prefecture, where he died.
translations.idiomatic: The court, fearing he might provoke incidents, transferred him to Longxing Prefecture, where he died.

sentences.zh: 誼嘗與紹興老將接，於行陣之法，分數奇正，皆有指授，自為圖式。

translations.literal: Yi had once associated with veteran generals of the Shaoxing era; in methods of battle formations, deployment, and the use of orthodox and unorthodox tactics, he had instruction for all and drew diagrams himself.
translations.idiomatic: Yi had once consorted with veteran generals of the Shaoxing era and had been instructed in battle formations, troop dispositions, and orthodox and unorthodox tactics, for which he drew diagrams of his own.

sentences.zh: 後謚「忠文」。

translations.literal: Later he was given the posthumous title "Loyal and Cultured."
translations.idiomatic: He was later given the posthumous title Loyal and Cultured.

sentences.zh: 吳獵，字德夫，潭州醴陵人。

translations.literal: Wu Lie, style name Defu, was a man of Liling in Tanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Lie, whose style name was Defu, came from Liling in Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 登進士第，初主潯州平南簿。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination and at first served as registrar of Pingnan in Xun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination and first served as registrar of Pingnan in Xun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 時張栻經略廣西，檄攝靜江府教授。

translations.literal: At the time Zhang Shi was commissioner for Guangxi and by order had him act as professor at Jingjiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Zhang Shi was commissioner for Guangxi and ordered him to serve as acting professor at Jingjiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 劉焞代栻，栻以獵薦，辟本司準備差遣。

translations.literal: Liu Chun replaced Shi; Shi recommended Lie, who was appointed preparatory agent of the commission.
translations.idiomatic: When Liu Chun replaced Zhang Shi, Shi recommended Lie, who was appointed preparatory agent on the commission's staff.

sentences.zh: 盜李接起，陷容、雷、高、化、貴、鬱林等州，獵請賞勞誅罪，焞於是錄鬱林功，誅南流縣尉、鬱林巡檢，人人驚厲，爭死鬥，不逾時，盜悉就擒。

translations.literal: The bandit Li Jie rose and seized Rong, Lei, Gao, Hua, Gui, Yulin, and other prefectures; Lie requested rewards for merit and punishments for crimes, and Chun thereupon recorded Yulin's merit, executed the Nanliu county lieutenant and the Yulin inspector, and everyone was stirred to fight to the death; before long all the bandits were captured.
translations.idiomatic: The bandit Li Jie rose and seized Rong, Lei, Gao, Hua, Gui, Yulin, and other prefectures. Lie urged rewards for merit and punishment for failure; Chun then recorded Yulin's achievements, executed the Nanliu county lieutenant and the Yulin inspector, and everyone fought desperately; before long all the bandits were captured.

sentences.zh: 尉，宰相王淮甥也，獵坐降官。

translations.literal: The lieutenant was the nephew of Chief Minister Wang Huai, and Lie was demoted for it.
translations.idiomatic: The lieutenant was a nephew of Chief Minister Wang Huai, and Lie was demoted on that account.

sentences.zh: 久之，知常州無錫縣。

translations.literal: After a long while he became magistrate of Wuxi in Chang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: After a long while he became magistrate of Wuxi in Chang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 用陳傅良薦，召試，守正字。

translations.literal: On Chen Fuliang's recommendation he was summoned for examination and appointed Erudite of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On Chen Fuliang's recommendation he was summoned for examination and appointed Erudite of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 光宗以疾久不覲重華宮，獵上疏曰：「今慈福有八十之大母，重華有垂白之二親，陛下宜於此時問安上壽，恪共子職。」

translations.literal: Because of illness Emperor Guangzong long failed to visit the Chonghua Palace; Lie submitted a memorial saying: "Now at Cifu there is a great-grandmother of eighty, and at Chonghua two parents whose hair has turned white—the Your Majesty should at this time inquire after their health and wish them long life, diligently fulfilling a son's duty."
translations.idiomatic: Because of illness Emperor Guangzong long failed to visit the Chonghua Palace. Lie submitted a memorial: "At Cifu there is a great-grandmother of eighty, and at Chonghua two parents whose hair has turned white—Your Majesty should now inquire after their health and wish them long life, faithfully fulfilling a son's duty."

sentences.zh: 辭甚切。

translations.literal: His language was very urgent.
translations.idiomatic: His language was urgent in the extreme.

sentences.zh: 又白宰相留正，乞召朱熹、楊萬里。

translations.literal: He also informed Chief Minister Liu Zheng, requesting that Zhu Xi and Yang Wanli be summoned.
translations.idiomatic: He also informed Chief Minister Liu Zheng and asked that Zhu Xi and Yang Wanli be summoned.

sentences.zh: 時陳傅良以言過宮事不行求去，獵責之曰：「今安危之機，判然可見，未聞有牽裾折檻之士。

translations.literal: At the time Chen Fuliang, because his words on visiting the palace had not been carried out, sought to resign; Lie reproached him, saying: "Now the hinge of safety and peril is plainly visible, yet one hears of no gentleman who seizes the emperor's robe or breaks the balustrade.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Chen Fuliang, because his advice on visiting the palace had not been heeded, sought to resign. Lie reproached him: "The hinge of the state's safety is plainly visible, yet we hear of no one seizing the emperor's robe or breaking the balustrade in remonstrance.

sentences.zh: 公不於此時有所奮發，為士大夫倡，第潔身而去，於國奚益！」

translations.literal: You do not at this time rouse yourself and lead the scholar-officials, but merely keep your person clean and leave—what benefit is there to the state!"
translations.idiomatic: You do not rouse yourself at this moment to lead the scholar-officials, but merely keep your person clean and withdraw—what good does that do the state!"

sentences.zh: 傅良為改容謝之。

translations.literal: Fuliang changed expression and apologized to him.
translations.idiomatic: Fuliang changed expression and apologized.

sentences.zh: 寧宗即位，遷校書郎，除監察御史。

translations.literal: When Emperor Ningzong took the throne, he was promoted to collator and appointed investigating censor.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Ningzong ascended the throne, Lie was promoted to collator and appointed investigating censor.

sentences.zh: 上趣修大內，將移御，獵言：「壽皇破漢、魏以來之薄俗，服高宗三年之喪，陛下萬一輕去喪次，將無以慰在天之靈。」

translations.literal: The emperor hastened to repair the inner palace and was about to move his residence; Lie said: "Emperor Shouhuang broke the shallow customs since Han and Wei and observed the three-year mourning of Emperor Gaozong—if Your Majesty by any chance lightly leaves the mourning quarters, you will have no means to comfort his spirit in Heaven."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor hastened repairs to the inner palace and was about to move his residence. Lie said: "Emperor Shouhuang broke the shallow customs since Han and Wei and observed the three-year mourning prescribed for Emperor Gaozong—if Your Majesty lightly leaves the mourning quarters, you will have no means to comfort his spirit in Heaven."

sentences.zh: 又言：「陛下即位，未見上皇，宜篤厲精誠，以俟上皇和豫而祗見焉。」

translations.literal: He also said: "Since Your Majesty took the throne you have not yet seen the Retired Emperor; you should deepen and strengthen your sincerity and wait until the Retired Emperor is at ease before reverently appearing before him."
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "Since Your Majesty ascended the throne you have not yet seen the Retired Emperor; deepen your sincerity and wait until he is at ease before reverently appearing before him."

sentences.zh: 會偽學禁興，獵言：「陛下臨御未數月，今日出一紙去宰相，明日出一紙去諫臣，昨又聞侍講朱熹遽以御劄畀祠，中外惶駭，謂事不出於中書，是謂亂政。」

translations.literal: When the proscription of so-called false learning arose, Lie said: "Your Majesty has ruled only a few months; today one slip of paper removes a chief minister, tomorrow another removes a remonstrating official; yesterday it was also heard that Lecturer-in-Waiting Zhu Xi was suddenly given a palace edict assigning him to a sacrificial post—inside and outside are alarmed and say that affairs do not come from the Secretariat; this is called disordering government."
translations.idiomatic: When the proscription of so-called false learning arose, Lie said: "Your Majesty has reigned only a few months; today one edict removes a chief minister, tomorrow another removes a remonstrating official; yesterday Lecturer-in-Waiting Zhu Xi was suddenly given a palace edict assigning him to a sacrificial post. Court and country are alarmed, saying that affairs no longer come from the Secretariat—this is disordering government."

sentences.zh: 獵既駁史浩謚，又請以張浚配享阜陵曰：「艱難以來，首倡大義，不以成敗利鈍異其心，精忠茂烈，貫日月、動天地，未有過於張浚也。

translations.literal: Lie had already opposed Shi Hao's posthumous title and also requested that Zhang Jun be granted secondary sacrifice at the tomb of Emperor Xiaozong, saying: "Since the time of hardship he was first to uphold the great cause and did not let success or failure, gain or loss alter his heart; his loyal devotion was lush and splendid, penetrating sun and moon and moving Heaven and earth—none has surpassed Zhang Jun.
translations.idiomatic: Lie had already opposed Shi Hao's posthumous title and also asked that Zhang Jun receive secondary sacrifice at Emperor Xiaozong's tomb, saying: "Since the time of hardship he was first to uphold the great cause and never let success or failure alter his heart; his loyal devotion was so splendid it penetrated sun and moon and moved Heaven and earth—none has surpassed Zhang Jun.

sentences.zh: 孝宗皇帝規恢之志，一飯不忘。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaozong's resolve to recover the lost territories—he never forgot it even at a single meal.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaozong's resolve to recover the lost territories—he never forgot it even over a single meal.

sentences.zh: 歷考相臣，終始此念，足以上配孝宗在天之意，亦惟浚一人耳。」

translations.literal: Examining all the chief ministers, only this intent from first to last is sufficient to match above Emperor Xiaozong's intent in Heaven—and only Jun alone."
translations.idiomatic: Surveying all the chief ministers, only this intent from first to last is sufficient to match Emperor Xiaozong's intent in Heaven—and only Jun alone."

sentences.zh: 議皆不合。

translations.literal: The proposals all failed to win approval.
translations.idiomatic: None of these proposals won approval.

sentences.zh: 出為江西轉運判官，尋劾罷。

translations.literal: He was sent out as transport commissioner of Jiangxi and soon impeached and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent out as transport commissioner of Jiangxi and soon impeached and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 久之，黨禁馳，起為廣西轉運判官，除戶部員外郎、總領湖廣江西京西財賦。

translations.literal: After a long while, when the factional ban eased, he was raised as transport commissioner of Guangxi, appointed Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue, and made overall intendant of the revenues of Huguang, Jiangxi, and Jingxi.
translations.idiomatic: After a long while, when the factional ban eased, he was raised as transport commissioner of Guangxi, made Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue, and appointed overall intendant of the revenues of Huguang, Jiangxi, and Jingxi.

sentences.zh: 韓侂胄議開邊，獵貽書當路，請號召義士以保邊場，刺子弟以補軍實，增棗陽、信陽之戍以備沖突，分屯陽羅五關以扞武昌，杜越境誘竊以謹邊隙，選試良家子以衛府庫。

translations.literal: When Han Tuozhou proposed opening hostilities on the frontier, Lie sent letters to those in power requesting that righteous volunteers be summoned to secure the borderlands, that young men be conscripted to fill out the army, that garrisons at Zaoyang and Xinyang be increased to guard against sudden attacks, that troops be stationed at the five passes of Yangluo to shield Wuchang, that cross-border enticement and theft be stopped to tighten the frontier, and that sons of good families be selected by examination to guard the treasuries.
translations.idiomatic: When Han Tuozhou proposed opening hostilities on the frontier, Lie wrote to those in power urging that righteous volunteers be summoned to secure the borderlands, young men conscripted to fill out the army, garrisons at Zaoyang and Xinyang strengthened against sudden attacks, troops stationed at the five passes of Yangluo to shield Wuchang, cross-border enticement and theft stopped to tighten the frontier, and sons of good families selected by examination to guard the treasuries.

sentences.zh: 且謂：「金人懲紹興末年之敗，今其來必出荊、襄逾湖。」

translations.literal: He also said: "The Jin, chastened by their defeat at the end of the Shaoxing era, if they come now will surely advance from Jing and Xiang and cross the lake."
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "Chastened by their defeat at the end of the Shaoxing era, if the Jin attack now they will surely advance from Jing and Xiang and cross the lake."

sentences.zh: 乃輸湖南米於襄陽，凡五十萬石；

translations.literal: He then shipped Hunan rice to Xiangyang, altogether five hundred thousand piculs;
translations.idiomatic: He then shipped five hundred thousand piculs of Hunan rice to Xiangyang;

sentences.zh: 又以湖北漕司和糴米三十萬石分輸荊、郢、安、信四郡；

translations.literal: and also used three hundred thousand piculs of tax-grain rice from the Hubei transport office, distributing it to the four prefectures of Jing, Ying, An, and Xin;
translations.idiomatic: and distributed three hundred thousand piculs of tax-grain rice from the Hubei transport office among the four prefectures of Jing, Ying, An, and Xin;

sentences.zh: 蓄銀帛百萬計以備進討；

translations.literal: stored silver and silks on the order of a million to prepare for an advance;
translations.idiomatic: stored silver and silks worth on the order of a million to prepare for an advance;

sentences.zh: 拔董逵、孟宗政、柴發等分列要郡，厥後皆為名將。

translations.literal: and promoted Dong Kui, Meng Zongzheng, Chai Fa, and others to key prefectures—all later became famous generals.
translations.idiomatic: and promoted Dong Kui, Meng Zongzheng, Chai Fa, and others to key prefectures; all later became famous generals.

sentences.zh: 召除秘書少監，首陳邊事，乞增光、鄂、江、黃四郡戍。

translations.literal: He was summoned and appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat, and first presented frontier affairs, requesting increased garrisons in the four prefectures of Guang, E, Jiang, and Huang.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned and appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat, and first presented frontier affairs, requesting increased garrisons in Guang, E, Jiang, and Huang prefectures.

sentences.zh: 屬江陵告饑，除秘閣修撰、主管荊湖北路安撫司公事、知江陵府。

translations.literal: As Jiangling reported famine, he was made Compiler at the Hanlin Archive, put in charge of the Jinghu North Route Pacification Commission, and appointed prefect of Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: When Jiangling reported famine, he was made Compiler at the Hanlin Archive, placed in charge of the Jinghu North Route Pacification Commission, and appointed prefect of Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 陛辭，請出大農十萬緡以振饑者。

translations.literal: On taking leave at court he requested that one hundred thousand strings from the Grand Agriculture treasury be released to relieve the famine.
translations.idiomatic: On taking leave at court he asked that one hundred thousand strings from the Grand Agriculture treasury be released to relieve the famine.

sentences.zh: 道武昌，遣人招商分糴；

translations.literal: Passing through Wuchang, he sent men to invite merchants to buy grain in shares;
translations.idiomatic: Passing through Wuchang, he sent men to invite merchants to buy grain in shares;

sentences.zh: 至郡，減價發糶，米價為平。

translations.literal: on reaching the prefecture he sold grain at reduced prices, and the price of rice became stable.
translations.idiomatic: and on reaching his prefecture he sold grain at reduced prices until the price of rice stabilized.

sentences.zh: 獵計金攻襄陽，則荊為重鎮，乃修成「高氏三海」，築金鸞、內湖、通濟、保安四匱，達於上海而注之中海；

translations.literal: Lie calculated that if the Jin attacked Xiangyang, Jing would be the key stronghold; he therefore completed the "Three Seas of the Gao clan," building the four reservoirs Jinjuan, Neihu, Tongji, and Bao'an, reaching the Upper Sea and pouring into the Middle Sea;
translations.idiomatic: Lie reckoned that if the Jin attacked Xiangyang, Jing would be the key stronghold; he therefore completed the "Three Seas of the Gao clan," building the four reservoirs Jinjuan, Neihu, Tongji, and Bao'an, channeling water to the Upper Sea and then into the Middle Sea;

sentences.zh: 拱辰、長林、藥山、棗林四匱，達於下海；

translations.literal: the four reservoirs Gongchen, Changlin, Yaoshan, and Zaolin, reaching the Lower Sea;
translations.idiomatic: the four reservoirs Gongchen, Changlin, Yaoshan, and Zaolin, reaching the Lower Sea;

sentences.zh: 分高沙、東獎之流，由寸金堤外歷南紀、楚望諸門，東匯沙市為南海。

translations.literal: and diverting the streams of Gaosha and Dongjiang, outside the Cunjin embankment passing through the gates of Nanji, Chu Wang, and others, eastward gathering at Shashi to form the Southern Sea.
translations.idiomatic: and diverting the streams of Gaosha and Dongjiang, outside the Cunjin embankment through the gates of Nanji, Chu Wang, and others, eastward gathering at Shashi to form the Southern Sea.

sentences.zh: 又於赤湖城西南遏走馬湖、熨斗陂之水，西北置李公匱，水勢四合，可限戎馬。

translations.literal: He also southwest of Chihu city checked the waters of Zouma Lake and Yidou Pond, and northwest set the Ligong reservoir; the waters converged on four sides and could hem in enemy cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: He also southwest of Chihu city dammed the waters of Zouma Lake and Yidou Pond, and northwest built the Ligong reservoir; with waters converging on four sides, enemy cavalry could be hemmed in.

sentences.zh: 金人圍襄陽、德安，遊騎迫竟陵，朝廷命獵節制本路兵馬。

translations.literal: The Jin besieged Xiangyang and De'an, and raiding cavalry pressed Jingling; the court ordered Lie to take overall command of the troops of this circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin besieged Xiangyang and De'an, and raiding cavalry pressed Jingling; the court ordered Lie to take overall command of the circuit's troops.

sentences.zh: 獵遣張榮將兵援竟陵，又招神馬陂潰卒得萬人，分援襄陽、德安。

translations.literal: Lie sent Zhang Rong to lead troops to relieve Jingling, and also recruited ten thousand routed soldiers from Shenma Slope, dividing them to aid Xiangyang and De'an.
translations.idiomatic: Lie sent Zhang Rong to lead troops to relieve Jingling and also recruited ten thousand routed soldiers from Shenma Slope, dividing them to aid Xiangyang and De'an.

sentences.zh: 加寶謨閣待制、京湖宣撫使。

translations.literal: He was added as Attendant Gentleman at the Baomo Pavilion and Commissioner for Pacification of Jing and Hu.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Attendant Gentleman at the Baomo Pavilion and Commissioner for Pacification of Jing and Hu.

sentences.zh: 時金人再犯竟陵，張榮死之，襄陽、德安俱急。

translations.literal: At the time the Jin again attacked Jingling; Zhang Rong died in battle, and both Xiangyang and De'an were in dire straits.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the Jin again attacked Jingling; Zhang Rong died in battle, and both Xiangyang and De'an were in dire straits.

sentences.zh: 吳曦俄反於蜀，警報至，獵請魏了翁攝參議官，訪以西事，募死士入竟陵，命其將王宗廉死守，調大軍及忠義、保捷分道夾擊，金人遂去。

translations.literal: Wu Xi soon rebelled in Shu; when the alarm arrived, Lie requested that Wei Liaoweng act as deliberative officer and consulted him on western affairs, recruited dare-to-die men into Jingling, ordered his general Wang Zonglian to defend to the death, and deployed the main army together with the Loyal and Righteous and Baojie units to strike from several routes—the Jin then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Xi soon rebelled in Shu; when the alarm arrived, Lie asked Wei Liaoweng to serve as deliberative officer and consulted him on western affairs, recruited dare-to-die men into Jingling, ordered his general Wang Zonglian to defend to the death, and deployed the main army together with the Loyal and Righteous and Baojie units to strike from several routes until the Jin withdrew.

sentences.zh: 又督董逵等援德安，董世雄、孟宗政等解襄陽之圍。

translations.literal: He also supervised Dong Kui and others in relieving De'an, while Dong Shixiong, Meng Zongzheng, and others lifted the siege of Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: He also supervised Dong Kui and others in relieving De'an, while Dong Shixiong, Meng Zongzheng, and others lifted the siege of Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 西事方殷，獵為討叛計，請於朝，以王大才、彭輅任西事，仍分兵抗均、房諸險，漕粟歸、峽以待王師。

translations.literal: Western affairs were pressing; Lie made plans to suppress the rebellion and requested of the court that Wang Dacai and Peng Lu take charge of western affairs, while still dividing troops to hold the passes of Jun and Fang, and transporting grain via Gui and Xia to await the imperial army.
translations.idiomatic: With western affairs pressing, Lie planned to suppress the rebellion and asked the court to put Wang Dacai and Peng Lu in charge of western affairs, divide troops to hold the passes of Jun and Fang, and transport grain via Gui and Xia to await the imperial army.

sentences.zh: 及曦誅，除刑部侍郎，充四川宣諭使。

translations.literal: When Xi was executed, he was appointed Vice Minister of Justice and made Pacification Commissioner of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: When Xi was executed, Lie was appointed Vice Minister of Justice and made Pacification Commissioner of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 朝廷命旌別淑慝。

translations.literal: The court ordered that the worthy and the wicked be distinguished and rewarded or punished.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered that the loyal and the disloyal be distinguished and rewarded or punished accordingly.

sentences.zh: 以敷文閣學士、四川安撫制置使兼知成都府。

translations.literal: He was made Academician of the Fuwen Pavilion, Commissioner for Pacification and Settlement of Sichuan, and concurrently prefect of Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Academician of the Fuwen Pavilion, Commissioner for Pacification and Settlement of Sichuan, and concurrently prefect of Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 嘉定六年召還，卒，家無餘資。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Jiading he was recalled and died; his household had no surplus wealth.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of the Jiading reign he was recalled and died, leaving his household with no surplus wealth.

sentences.zh: 蜀人思其政，畫像祠之。

translations.literal: The people of Shu missed his governance and painted his portrait to worship him.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Shu missed his governance and painted his portrait for veneration.

sentences.zh: 獵初從張栻學，乾道初，朱熹會栻於潭，獵又親炙，湖湘之學一出於正，獵實表率之。

translations.literal: Lie at first studied under Zhang Shi; at the beginning of Qiandao Zhu Xi met Shi in Tan, and Lie again received instruction at close hand—the learning of Huguang and Hunan issued wholly in the right direction, and Lie was truly its exemplar.
translations.idiomatic: Lie had first studied under Zhang Shi; at the beginning of the Qiandao reign Zhu Xi met Shi in Tan, and Lie again received instruction at close hand—the learning of Huguang and Hunan issued wholly in the right direction, and Lie was truly its exemplar.

sentences.zh: 有《畏齋文集》、奏議六十卷。

translations.literal: He had the Collected Works of the Reverent Studio and sixty juan of memorials.
translations.idiomatic: He left the Collected Works of the Reverent Studio and sixty juan of memorials.

sentences.zh: 謚「文定」。

translations.literal: His posthumous title was "Cultured and Settled."
translations.idiomatic: He was given the posthumous title Cultured and Settled.

sentences.zh: 項安世

translations.literal: Xiang Anshi
translations.idiomatic: Xiang Anshi

sentences.zh: 項安世，字平父，其先括蒼人，後家江陵。

translations.literal: Xiang Anshi, style name Pingfu, his ancestors were men of Kuocang, and later the family settled in Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang Anshi, whose style name was Pingfu, came originally from Kuocang but later made his home in Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 淳熙二年進士，召試，除秘書正字。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chunxi he became a jinshi, was summoned for examination, and appointed Regular Scribe of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the second year of the Chunxi reign, was summoned for examination, and appointed Regular Scribe of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 光宗以疾不過重華宮，安世上書言：「陛下仁足以覆天下，而不能施愛於庭闈之間；

translations.literal: Because of illness Emperor Guangzong did not visit the Chonghua Palace; Anshi submitted a memorial saying: "Your Majesty's benevolence is sufficient to cover all under Heaven, yet you cannot extend love within the inner quarters of the palace;
translations.idiomatic: Because of illness Emperor Guangzong did not visit the Chonghua Palace. Anshi submitted a memorial: "Your Majesty's benevolence is sufficient to shelter all under Heaven, yet you cannot extend love within the palace family;

sentences.zh: 量足以容群臣，而不能忍於父子之際。

translations.literal: your magnanimity is sufficient to embrace all the ministers, yet you cannot forbear in the matter between father and son.
translations.idiomatic: your magnanimity is sufficient to embrace all your ministers, yet you cannot forbear in the matter between father and son.

sentences.zh: 以一身寄於六軍、萬姓之上，有父子然後有君臣。

translations.literal: With your single person entrusted above the Six Armies and the myriad people, there must be father and son before there can be ruler and minister.
translations.idiomatic: With your person entrusted above the Six Armies and the myriad people, there must be father and son before there can be ruler and minister.

sentences.zh: 願陛下自入思慮，父子之情，終無可斷之理；

translations.literal: I wish Your Majesty to enter into reflection yourself: the feeling between father and son ultimately has no principle by which it can be severed;
translations.idiomatic: I urge Your Majesty to reflect deeply: the bond between father and son ultimately cannot be severed;

sentences.zh: 愛敬之念，必有油然之時。

translations.literal: the thought of love and respect will surely have its moment of welling up.
translations.idiomatic: thoughts of love and respect will surely well up in their season.

sentences.zh: 聖心一回，何用擇日，早往則謂之省，暮往則謂之定。

translations.literal: Once the sage heart turns, what need is there to choose a day? Go early and it is called an inquiry visit; go in the evening and it is called a settling visit.
translations.idiomatic: Once your heart turns, what need is there to choose a day? Go early and it is an inquiry visit; go in the evening and it is a settling visit.

sentences.zh: 即日就駕，旋乾轉坤，在返掌間爾。」

translations.literal: Mount your carriage that very day—to turn heaven and earth lies within the turning of the palm."
translations.idiomatic: Mount your carriage that very day—to turn heaven and earth lies within the turn of your hand."

sentences.zh: 疏入不報。

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted but received no response.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was submitted but received no response.

sentences.zh: 安世遺宰相留正書求去，尋遷校書郎。

translations.literal: Anshi sent a letter to Chief Minister Liu Zheng asking to resign, and soon was promoted to collator.
translations.idiomatic: Anshi sent a letter to Chief Minister Liu Zheng asking to resign, and was soon promoted to collator.

sentences.zh: 寧宗即位，詔求言，安世應詔言：

translations.literal: When Emperor Ningzong took the throne, an edict sought opinions; Anshi responded to the edict, saying:
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Ningzong ascended the throne, an edict sought opinions; Anshi responded:

sentences.zh: 「管夷吾治齊，諸葛亮治蜀，立國之本，不過曰量地以制賦，量賦以制用而已。

translations.literal: "In governing Qi, Guan Zhong, and in governing Shu, Zhuge Liang—the foundation of establishing a state is nothing more than measuring land to fix levies and measuring levies to fix expenditure.
translations.idiomatic: "In governing Qi, Guan Zhong, and in governing Shu, Zhuge Liang—the foundation of establishing a state is nothing more than measuring land to fix levies and measuring levies to fix expenditure.

sentences.zh: 陛下試披輿地圖，今郡縣之數，比祖宗時孰為多少？

translations.literal: Your Majesty, try opening the geograph and map: compared with the time of the ancestors, which has more or fewer prefectures and counties today?
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty, try opening the geograph and map: compared with the age of the ancestors, which has more or fewer prefectures and counties today?

sentences.zh: 比秦、漢、隋、唐時孰為多少？

translations.literal: Compared with the Qin, Han, Sui, and Tang dynasties, which has more or fewer?
translations.idiomatic: Compared with the Qin, Han, Sui, and Tang dynasties, which has more or fewer?

sentences.zh: 陛下必自知其狹且少矣。

translations.literal: Your Majesty must already know that they are narrow and few.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty must already know how narrow and few they are.

sentences.zh: 試命版曹具一歲賦入之數，祖宗盛時，東南之賦入幾何？

translations.literal: Try ordering the Board of Revenue to prepare the figures for one year's tax revenue—in the flourishing age of the ancestors, how much was the revenue from the southeast?
translations.idiomatic: Try ordering the Board of Revenue to tally one year's tax receipts—in the ancestors' flourishing age, how much revenue came from the southeast?

sentences.zh: 建炎、紹興以來至乾道、淳熙，其所增取幾何？

translations.literal: From the Jianyan and Shaoxing eras through Qiandao and Chunxi, how much was added to the levies?
translations.idiomatic: From the Jianyan and Shaoxing eras through Qiandao and Chunxi, how much more was taken in levies?

sentences.zh: 陛下試命內外群臣有司具一歲之用，人主供奉、好賜之費幾何？

translations.literal: Your Majesty, try ordering all officials inside and outside the court to prepare the year's expenditure—how much for the ruler's provisions and discretionary gifts?
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty, try ordering all officials inside and outside the court to tally one year's spending—how much for the ruler's provisions and discretionary gifts?

sentences.zh: 御前工役、器械之費幾何？

translations.literal: How much for Imperial Workshop labor and equipment?
translations.idiomatic: How much for Imperial Workshop labor and equipment?

sentences.zh: 嬪嬙、宦寺廩給之費幾何？

translations.literal: How much for stipends to consorts and eunuchs?
translations.idiomatic: How much for stipends to consorts and eunuchs?

sentences.zh: 戶部、四總領養兵之費幾何？

translations.literal: How much for the Ministry of Revenue and the four chief military commissioners to maintain troops?
translations.idiomatic: How much for the Ministry of Revenue and the four chief military commissioners to maintain troops?

sentences.zh: 州縣公使、迎送、請給之費幾何？

translations.literal: How much for prefectural and county envoys, escorts, and entitlements?
translations.idiomatic: How much for prefectural and county envoys, escorts, and perquisites?

sentences.zh: 陛下必自知其為侈且濫矣！

translations.literal: Your Majesty must already know that it is extravagant and excessive!
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty must already know how extravagant and excessive it is!

sentences.zh: 用不量賦而至於侈且濫，內外上下之積不得而不空，天地山川之藏不得而不竭，非忍痛耐謗，一舉而更張之，未知其所以終也。

translations.literal: When expenditure is not measured against levies and thus becomes extravagant and excessive, the accumulated reserves above and below, inside and outside, cannot but be emptied, and the stores of heaven, earth, mountains, and rivers cannot but be exhausted—unless one endures pain and withstands slander to overhaul everything at once, one cannot know how it will end.
translations.idiomatic: When spending is not measured against revenue and grows extravagant and excessive, reserves above and below, inside and outside, cannot but be drained, and the stores of heaven, earth, mountains, and rivers cannot but be exhausted—unless one endures hardship and withstands slander to overhaul everything at once, one cannot know how it will end.

sentences.zh: 今天下之費最重而當省者，兵也。

translations.literal: Today the heaviest expense under Heaven that ought to be reduced is the military.
translations.idiomatic: Today the heaviest expense under Heaven that ought to be cut is the military.

sentences.zh: 能用土兵則兵可省，能用屯田則兵可省。

translations.literal: If local troops can be used, the military can be reduced; if garrison farming can be used, the military can be reduced.
translations.idiomatic: If local troops can be used, military costs can be cut; if garrison farming can be used, military costs can be cut.

sentences.zh: 其次莫如宮掖。

translations.literal: Next to that, nothing compares to the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: Next to that, nothing compares to the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 兵以待敵國，常畏而不敢省，故省兵難。

translations.literal: The military stands ready against enemy states—one always fears and dare not reduce it, so reducing the military is hard.
translations.idiomatic: The military stands ready against enemy states—one always fears and dare not cut it, so cutting military costs is hard.

sentences.zh: 宮掖以私一身，常愛而不忍省，故省宮掖難。

translations.literal: The inner palace serves one's private person—one always cherishes it and cannot bear to reduce it, so reducing the inner palace is hard.
translations.idiomatic: The inner palace serves one's private comfort—one always cherishes it and cannot bear to cut it, so cutting palace costs is hard.

sentences.zh: 不敢省者，事在他人；

translations.literal: What one dare not reduce lies with others;
translations.idiomatic: What one dare not cut lies with others;

sentences.zh: 不忍省者，在陛下。

translations.literal: what one cannot bear to reduce lies with Your Majesty.
translations.idiomatic: what one cannot bear to cut lies with Your Majesty.

sentences.zh: 宮中之嬙嬪、宦寺，陛下事也，宮中之器械、工役，陛下事也，陛下肯省則省之。

translations.literal: The consorts and eunuchs in the palace are Your Majesty's affair; the equipment and labor in the palace are Your Majesty's affair—if Your Majesty is willing to reduce them, reduce them.
translations.idiomatic: The consorts and eunuchs in the palace are Your Majesty's affair; the equipment and labor in the palace are Your Majesty's affair—if Your Majesty is willing to cut them, cut them.

sentences.zh: 宮中既省，則外廷之官吏，四方之州縣，從風而省，奔走不暇，簡樸成風，民志堅定，民生日厚，雖有水旱蟲蝗之災，可活也；

translations.literal: Once the palace is reduced, the officials of the outer court and the prefectures and counties in all directions will follow the wind and reduce spending, too busy to pause—simplicity will become the fashion, the people's resolve will be firm, the people's livelihood will grow richer, and even if there are disasters of flood, drought, insects, or locusts, they can survive;
translations.idiomatic: Once the palace is cut back, outer-court officials and prefectures and counties everywhere will follow suit, too busy to pause—simplicity will become the fashion, the people's resolve will firm up, their livelihood will grow richer, and even if flood, drought, insects, or locusts strike, they can survive;

sentences.zh: 國力日壯，雖有夷狄盜賊之變，可為也。

translations.literal: National strength will daily grow robust, and even if there are upheavals from barbarians or bandits, one can act.
translations.idiomatic: National strength will daily grow robust, and even if barbarians or bandits rise up, one can act.

sentences.zh: 復祖宗之業，雪人神之憤，惟吾所為，無不可者。」

translations.literal: To restore the ancestors' enterprise and appease the wrath of gods and men—whatever we undertake, nothing is impossible."
translations.idiomatic: To restore the ancestors' enterprise and appease the wrath of gods and men—whatever we undertake, nothing is impossible."

sentences.zh: 時朱熹召至闕，未幾予祠，安世率館職上書留之，言：「御筆除熹宮祠，不經宰執，不由給舍，徑使快行，直送熹家。

translations.literal: At the time Zhu Xi was summoned to court, and soon was granted a temple appointment. Anshi led the staff of the Hanlin Academy in submitting a memorial asking to retain him, saying: "By imperial brush Xi was dismissed to a temple post, without going through the chief ministers, without passing through the remonstrance and drafting offices—it was hurried through directly and sent straight to Xi's home.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Zhu Xi was summoned to court, and soon was granted a temple appointment. Anshi led the Hanlin Academy staff in submitting a memorial asking to retain him, saying: "By imperial brush Xi was dismissed to a temple post, without going through the chief ministers, without passing through the remonstrance and drafting offices—it was hurried through directly and sent straight to Xi's home.

sentences.zh: 竊揣聖意，必明知熹賢不當使去，宰相見之必執奏，給舍見之必繳駁，是以為此駭異變常之舉也。

translations.literal: We venture to surmise the sage intent: surely you clearly knew that Xi is worthy and should not be made to leave—had the chief minister seen it he would surely have remonstrated and memorialized, had the remonstrance and drafting offices seen it they would surely have returned it for rejection—therefore this startling, irregular, unprecedented act was taken.
translations.idiomatic: We venture to surmise the imperial intent: surely you clearly knew that Xi was worthy and should not be made to leave—had the chief minister seen it he would surely have remonstrated, had the remonstrance and drafting offices seen it they would surely have returned it for rejection—therefore this startling, irregular act was taken.

sentences.zh: 夫人主患不知賢爾，明知其賢而明去之，是示天下以不復用賢也。

translations.literal: The trouble of a ruler is not knowing the worthy—that is all; to know clearly that someone is worthy and yet clearly remove him is to show all under Heaven that the worthy will no longer be employed.
translations.idiomatic: A ruler's trouble is not knowing the worthy—that is all; to know clearly that someone is worthy and yet clearly remove him is to show all under Heaven that the worthy will no longer be employed.

sentences.zh: 人主患不聞公議爾，明知公議之不可而明犯之，是示天下以不復顧公議也。

translations.literal: The trouble of a ruler is not hearing public opinion—that is all; to know clearly that public opinion cannot be defied and yet clearly violate it is to show all under Heaven that public opinion will no longer be heeded.
translations.idiomatic: A ruler's trouble is not hearing public opinion—that is all; to know clearly that public opinion cannot be defied and yet clearly violate it is to show all under Heaven that public opinion will no longer be heeded.

sentences.zh: 且朱熹本一庶官，在二千里外，陛下即位未數日，即加號召，畀以從官，俾侍經幄，天下皆以為初政之美。

translations.literal: Moreover, Zhu Xi was originally a common official, two thousand li away—within days of Your Majesty's accession you added an honorific title and summoned him, appointing him as an attendant official and having him serve at the classics mat—all under Heaven regarded it as the beauty of the opening administration.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, Zhu Xi was originally a common official, two thousand li away—within days of Your Majesty's accession you added an honorific title and summoned him, appointing him as an attendant official and having him serve at the classics mat—all under Heaven regarded it as the beauty of the opening administration.

sentences.zh: 供職甫四十日，即以內批逐之，舉朝驚愕，不知所措。

translations.literal: He had served barely forty days when he was driven out by an inner rescript—the whole court was astonished and did not know what to do.
translations.idiomatic: He had served barely forty days when he was driven out by an inner rescript—the whole court was astonished and did not know what to do.

sentences.zh: 臣願陛下謹守紀綱，毋忽公議，復留朱熹，使輔聖學，則人主無失，公議尚存。」

translations.literal: Your subject wishes Your Majesty to carefully guard the laws and regulations, not to neglect public opinion, to restore Zhu Xi and have him assist in sage learning—then the ruler will be without fault and public opinion will still survive."
translations.idiomatic: Your subject wishes Your Majesty to carefully guard the laws and regulations, not to neglect public opinion, to restore Zhu Xi and have him assist in sage learning—then the ruler will be without fault and public opinion will still survive."

sentences.zh: 不報。

translations.literal: No response was received.
translations.idiomatic: No response was received.

sentences.zh: 俄為言者劾去，通判重慶府，未拜，以偽黨罷。

translations.literal: Soon he was impeached and removed by censors, appointed vice prefect of Chongqing Prefecture, but before he could assume the post he was dismissed as a member of the false faction.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was impeached and removed by censors, appointed vice prefect of Chongqing Prefecture, but before he could assume the post he was dismissed as a member of the false faction.

sentences.zh: 安世素善吳獵，二人坐學禁久廢。

translations.literal: Anshi had long been on good terms with Wu Lie; both were long idled for the learning prohibition.
translations.idiomatic: Anshi had long been on good terms with Wu Lie; both were long idled under the learning prohibition.

sentences.zh: 開禧用兵，獵起帥荊渚，安世方丁內艱。

translations.literal: When the Kaixi campaign began, Lie was recalled to command Jingzhou; Anshi was then in mourning for his mother.
translations.idiomatic: When the Kaixi campaign began, Lie was recalled to command Jingzhou; Anshi was then in mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 起復，知鄂州。

translations.literal: Recalled from mourning, he was made prefect of Ezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled from mourning, he was made prefect of Ezhou.

sentences.zh: 俄淮、漢師潰，薛叔似以怯懦為侂胄所惡，安世因貽侂胄書，其末曰：「偶送客至江頭，飲竹光酒，半醉，書不成字。」

translations.literal: Soon the armies on the Huai and Han collapsed. Xue Shusi was hated by Han Tuozhou for cowardice. Anshi therefore sent Tuozhou a letter, at the end of which he wrote: "I happened to see a guest off to the riverbank, drank Zhuguang wine, was half drunk, and the writing does not form characters."
translations.idiomatic: Soon the armies on the Huai and Han collapsed. Xue Shusi was hated by Han Tuozhou for cowardice. Anshi therefore sent Tuozhou a letter, at the end of which he wrote: "I happened to see a guest off to the riverbank, drank Zhuguang wine, was half drunk, and the writing does not form characters."

sentences.zh: 侂胄大喜曰：「項平父乃爾閑暇。」

translations.literal: Tuozhou was greatly pleased and said: "Xiang Pingfu is thus at leisure."
translations.idiomatic: Tuozhou was greatly pleased and said: "Xiang Pingfu is thus at leisure."

sentences.zh: 遂除戶部員外郎、湖廣總領。

translations.literal: He was then appointed vice minister of revenue and chief commissioner for Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: He was then appointed vice minister of revenue and chief commissioner for Huguang.

sentences.zh: 會叔似罷，金圍德安益急，諸將無所屬。

translations.literal: Just then Shusi was dismissed. The Jin besieged De'an ever more tightly, and the generals had no one to whom they belonged.
translations.idiomatic: Just then Shusi was dismissed. The Jin besieged De'an ever more tightly, and the generals had no one to answer to.

sentences.zh: 安世不俟朝命，徑遣兵解圍。

translations.literal: Anshi did not wait for court orders and directly dispatched troops to relieve the siege.
translations.idiomatic: Anshi did not wait for court orders and directly dispatched troops to relieve the siege.

sentences.zh: 高悅等與金人力戰，馬雄獲萬戶，周勝獲千戶，安世第其功以聞。

translations.literal: Gao Yue and others fought the Jin forces fiercely; Ma Xiong captured a wanhu, Zhou Sheng captured a qianhu—Anshi ranked their merits and reported them.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Yue and others fought the Jin forces fiercely; Ma Xiong captured a wanhu commander, Zhou Sheng captured a qianhu commander—Anshi ranked their merits and reported them.

sentences.zh: 獵代叔似為宣撫使，尋以宣諭使入蜀。

translations.literal: Lie replaced Shusi as pacification commissioner; soon he entered Shu as grand pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Lie replaced Shusi as pacification commissioner; soon he entered Shu as grand pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 朝命安世權宣撫使，又升太府卿。

translations.literal: The court ordered Anshi to serve as acting pacification commissioner and further promoted him to director of the imperial storehouse.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Anshi to serve as acting pacification commissioner and further promoted him to director of the imperial storehouse.

sentences.zh: 有宣撫幕官王度者，吳獵客也。

translations.literal: There was a pacification commission staff officer named Wang Du, who was Wu Lie's guest.
translations.idiomatic: There was a pacification commission staff officer named Wang Du, who was Wu Lie's guest.

sentences.zh: 獵與安世素相友，及安世招軍，名項家軍，多不逞，好虜掠，獵斬其為首者，安世憾之，至是斬度於大別寺。

translations.literal: Lie and Anshi had long been friends. When Anshi recruited troops called the Xiang Family Army, many were unruly and fond of plunder. Lie executed the ringleaders; Anshi resented this, and at this time executed Du at the Dabie temple.
translations.idiomatic: Lie and Anshi had long been friends. When Anshi recruited troops called the Xiang Family Army, many were unruly and fond of plunder. Lie executed the ringleaders; Anshi resented this, and at this time executed Du at the Dabie temple.

sentences.zh: 獵聞於朝，安世坐免。

translations.literal: Lie reported this to court, and Anshi was dismissed on that account.
translations.idiomatic: Lie reported this to court, and Anshi was dismissed on that account.

sentences.zh: 後以直龍圖閣為湖南轉運判官，未上，用臺章奪職而罷。

translations.literal: Later, with the designation of direct Hanlin academician, he was made transport vice commissioner of Hunan; before he took up the post, a censorial memorial stripped him of his post and dismissed him.
translations.idiomatic: Later, with the designation of direct Hanlin academician, he was made transport vice commissioner of Hunan; before he took up the post, a censorial memorial stripped him of his post and dismissed him.

sentences.zh: 嘉定元年，卒。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiading, he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jiading, he died.

sentences.zh: 所著《易玩辭》、他書，多行於世。

translations.literal: His works *Play on the Words of the Changes* and other books circulated widely in his day.
translations.idiomatic: His works *Play on the Words of the Changes* and other books circulated widely in his day.

sentences.zh: 薛叔似

translations.literal: Xue Shusi
translations.idiomatic: Xue Shusi

sentences.zh: 薛叔似，字象先，其先河東人，後徙永嘉。

translations.literal: Xue Shusi, styled Xiangxian, was originally from Hedong; his family later moved to Yongjia.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Shusi, styled Xiangxian, was originally from Hedong; his family later moved to Yongjia.

sentences.zh: 遊太學，解褐國子錄。

translations.literal: He studied at the Imperial Academy and upon leaving office robes became recorder of the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: He studied at the Imperial Academy and upon leaving office robes became recorder of the Directorate of Education.

sentences.zh: 初登對，論：「祖宗立國之初，除二稅外，取民甚輕。

translations.literal: On his first audience, he argued: "At the founding of the state by the ancestors, apart from the two taxes, levies on the people were very light.
translations.idiomatic: On his first audience, he argued: "At the founding of the state by the ancestors, apart from the two taxes, levies on the people were very light.

sentences.zh: 自熙寧以來，賦日增而民困滋甚。」

translations.literal: Since the Xining era, levies have daily increased and the people's distress has grown ever worse."
translations.idiomatic: Since the Xining era, levies have daily increased and the people's distress has grown ever worse."

sentences.zh: 孝宗嘉納，因曰：「朕在宮中如一僧。」

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaozong praised and accepted this, and then said: "Within the palace I am like a monk."
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaozong praised and accepted this, and then said: "Within the palace I am like a monk."

sentences.zh: 叔似曰「此非所望於陛下，當論功業如何。

translations.literal: Shusi said, "This is not what is hoped for from Your Majesty—you should discuss what the achievements are like.
translations.idiomatic: Shusi said, "This is not what is hoped for from Your Majesty—you should discuss what the achievements are like.

sentences.zh: 正使海內富庶如文、景，不過江左之文、景；

translations.literal: Even if the realm within the seas were as prosperous as the Wen and Jing reigns, it would be no more than the Wen and Jing of the Jiang left;
translations.idiomatic: Even if the realm within the seas were as prosperous as the Wen and Jing reigns, it would be no more than the Wen and Jing of the Jiang left;

sentences.zh: 法度修明如明、章，不過江左之明、章。

translations.literal: even if laws and institutions were as well ordered as the Ming and Zhang reigns, it would be no more than the Ming and Zhang of the Jiang left.
translations.idiomatic: even if laws and institutions were as well ordered as the Ming and Zhang reigns, it would be no more than the Ming and Zhang of the Jiang left.

sentences.zh: 陛下即位二十餘年，國勢未張，未免牽於茍安無事之說。」

translations.literal: Your Majesty has been on the throne more than twenty years, yet national strength has not expanded—you cannot but be tethered to talk of temporary peace with nothing to do."
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty has been on the throne more than twenty years, yet national strength has not expanded—you cannot but be tethered to talk of temporary peace with nothing to do."

sentences.zh: 上默然。

translations.literal: The emperor was silent.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was silent.

sentences.zh: 復數日，宰執進擬朝士，上出寸紙書叔似及應孟明姓名，嘉其奏對也。

translations.literal: A few days later, when the chief ministers submitted proposed appointments for court officials, the emperor produced a slip of paper on which he had written the names of Shusi and Ying Mengming, commending their answers at audience.
translations.idiomatic: A few days later, when the chief ministers submitted proposed appointments for court officials, the emperor produced a slip of paper on which he had written the names of Shusi and Ying Mengming, commending their answers at audience.

sentences.zh: 遷太常博士，尋除樞密院編修官。

translations.literal: He was transferred to erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and soon appointed compilation officer of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and soon appointed compilation officer of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 時仿唐制，置補闕、拾遺，宰臣啟，擬令侍從、臺諫薦人，上自除叔似左補闕。

translations.literal: At the time, following the Tang system, remonstrance and review posts were established. The chief ministers reported and proposed that attendants and censors recommend candidates; the emperor personally appointed Shusi as Left Remonstrance Officer.
translations.idiomatic: At the time, following the Tang system, remonstrance and review posts were established. The chief ministers reported and proposed that attendants and censors recommend candidates; the emperor personally appointed Shusi as Left Remonstrance Officer.

sentences.zh: 叔似論事，遂劾首相王淮去位。

translations.literal: Shusi remonstrated on affairs and impeached Chief Minister Wang Huai, who left his post.
translations.idiomatic: Shusi remonstrated on affairs and impeached Chief Minister Wang Huai, who left his post.

sentences.zh: 屬金主殂，太孫景立，叔似奏：「規模果定，則乘五單于爭立之機；

translations.literal: When the Jin ruler died and the crown prince Jing succeeded, Shusi memorialized: "If the overall strategy is fixed, then seize the opportunity of five chanyu contending for the throne;
translations.idiomatic: When the Jin ruler died and the crown prince Jing succeeded, Shusi memorialized: "If the overall strategy is fixed, then seize the opportunity of five chanyu contending for the throne;

sentences.zh: 規模不存，則恐成五胡叠起之勢。」

translations.literal: if the overall strategy is not preserved, I fear it will become the trend of the Five Barbarians rising in succession."
translations.idiomatic: if the overall strategy is not preserved, I fear it will become the trend of the Five Barbarians rising in succession."

sentences.zh: 光宗受禪，時傳金使入界使名未正，叔似奏：「自壽皇一正匹敵之禮，金人常有南顧之虞，使名未正而遽受之，祗以重其玩侮。」

translations.literal: When Emperor Guangzong received the abdication, it was reported that a Jin envoy had entered the border but his mission title was not yet correct. Shusi memorialized: "Since Emperor Shouhuang corrected the protocol of equal footing, the Jin people have always had concern about looking south—if the mission title is not corrected and he is hurriedly received, it will only increase their contempt."
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Guangzong received the abdication, it was reported that a Jin envoy had entered the border but his mission title was not yet correct. Shusi memorialized: "Since Emperor Shouhuang corrected the protocol of equal footing, the Jin people have always had concern about looking south—if the mission title is not corrected and he is hurriedly received, it will only increase their contempt."

sentences.zh: 翼日復奏：「謀國者畏敵太過。」

translations.literal: The next day he memorialized again: "Those who plan for the state fear the enemy too much."
translations.idiomatic: The next day he memorialized again: "Those who plan for the state fear the enemy too much."

sentences.zh: 上奮然開納。

translations.literal: The emperor, stirred, opened his mind and accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, stirred, opened his mind and accepted it.

sentences.zh: 除將作監，出為江東轉運判官。

translations.literal: He was appointed director of the Directorate of Imperial Construction and sent out as transport vice commissioner of Jiangdong.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed director of the Directorate of Imperial Construction and sent out as transport vice commissioner of Jiangdong.

sentences.zh: 俄以諫臣論罷，主管沖佑觀，尋除湖北運判，加直秘閣，移福建，召為太常少卿兼實錄院檢討官、守秘書監、權戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: Soon he was dismissed on remonstrance by censors, put in charge of the Chongyou Temple, soon appointed transport vice commissioner of Hubei, given the designation of direct secretariat drafter, transferred to Fujian, and summoned as vice director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and concurrently collation officer of the Veritable Records Institute, acting director of the Secretariat, and acting vice minister of revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was dismissed on remonstrance by censors, put in charge of the Chongyou Temple, soon appointed transport vice commissioner of Hubei, given the designation of direct secretariat drafter, transferred to Fujian, and summoned as vice director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and concurrently collation officer of the Veritable Records Institute, acting director of the Secretariat, and acting vice minister of revenue.

sentences.zh: 初，丞相周必大請擇侍從、臺諫忠直者提舉太史局，蓋用神宗朝司馬光與王安禮故事，躔度少差，豫圖銷弭，遂命叔似提舉。

translations.literal: Earlier, Chief Minister Zhou Bida requested that loyal and upright attendants and censors be chosen to supervise the Bureau of Astronomy, following the precedent of Sima Guang and Wang Anli in the Shenzong reign—slight deviations in the heavenly motions were anticipated and disaster averted in advance; Shusi was therefore ordered to supervise it.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Chief Minister Zhou Bida requested that loyal and upright attendants and censors be chosen to supervise the Bureau of Astronomy, following the precedent of Sima Guang and Wang Anli in the Shenzong reign—slight deviations in the heavenly motions were anticipated and disaster averted in advance; Shusi was therefore ordered to supervise it.

sentences.zh: 尋兼樞密都承旨，以劉德秀疏罷，提舉興國宮。

translations.literal: Soon he also served as chief military reception officer of the Bureau of Military Affairs; dismissed on a memorial by Liu Dexiu, he was put in charge of the Xingguo Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he also served as chief military reception officer of the Bureau of Military Affairs; dismissed on a memorial by Liu Dexiu, he was put in charge of the Xingguo Temple.

sentences.zh: 起知贛州，移隆興府、廬州，召除在京宮觀兼侍讀，進權兵部侍郎兼同修國史兼國用司參議官。

translations.literal: Recalled to serve as prefect of Ganzhou, transferred to Longxing Prefecture and Luzhou, summoned and appointed to a capital temple post concurrently as reader-in-waiting, and advanced to acting vice minister of war concurrently as co-compiler of the national history and deliberation officer of the Bureau of State Finance.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled to serve as prefect of Ganzhou, transferred to Longxing Prefecture and Luzhou, summoned and appointed to a capital temple post concurrently as reader-in-waiting, and advanced to acting vice minister of war concurrently as co-compiler of the national history and deliberation officer of the Bureau of State Finance.

sentences.zh: 兩浙民有身丁錢，叔似請於朝，遂蠲之。

translations.literal: The people of the Two Zhes had a per-capita head tax; Shusi petitioned the court, and it was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: The people of the Two Zhes had a per-capita head tax; Shusi petitioned the court, and it was remitted.

sentences.zh: 試吏部侍郎兼侍讀，充京、湖宣諭使。

translations.literal: He was tried out as vice minister of the civil office concurrently as reader-in-waiting and appointed grand pacification commissioner for Jing and Hu.
translations.idiomatic: He was tried out as vice minister of the civil office concurrently as reader-in-waiting and appointed grand pacification commissioner for Jing and Hu.

sentences.zh: 時韓侂胄開邊，除兵部尚書、宣撫使。

translations.literal: At the time Han Tuozhou opened hostilities on the frontier; Shusi was appointed minister of war and pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Han Tuozhou opened hostilities on the frontier; Shusi was appointed minister of war and pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 叔似方乞給降官會，分撥綱運，募兵鬻馬，辟致僚佐，而皇甫斌唐州之師已敗矣。

translations.literal: Shusi had just petitioned for imperial decree and meetings with subordinates, allocating convoy transport, recruiting troops and selling horses, and gathering staff officers—yet Huangfu Bin's army at Tangzhou had already been defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Shusi had just petitioned for imperial decree and meetings with subordinates, allocating convoy transport, recruiting troops and selling horses, and gathering staff officers—yet Huangfu Bin's army at Tangzhou had already been defeated.

sentences.zh: 遂劾斌，南安軍安置。

translations.literal: He then impeached Bin, who was settled in Nan'an Army.
translations.idiomatic: He then impeached Bin, who was settled in Nan'an Army.

sentences.zh: 叔似料敵必侵光、黃，委總領陳謙按行五關，發鄂卒守三關。

translations.literal: Shusi anticipated the enemy would surely invade Guang and Huang; he entrusted chief commissioner Chen Qian to inspect the five passes and dispatched Ezhou troops to guard the three passes.
translations.idiomatic: Shusi anticipated the enemy would surely invade Guang and Huang; he entrusted chief commissioner Chen Qian to inspect the five passes and dispatched Ezhou troops to guard the three passes.

sentences.zh: 金果入寇，謙駐漢陽為江左節制。

translations.literal: The Jin indeed invaded; Qian stationed at Hanyang as regional commander for the Jiang left.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin indeed invaded; Qian stationed at Hanyang as regional commander for the Jiang left.

sentences.zh: 尋除叔似端明殿學士兼侍讀。

translations.literal: Soon Shusi was appointed academician of the Hall for Venerating Brightness concurrently as reader-in-waiting.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Shusi was appointed academician of the Hall for Venerating Brightness concurrently as reader-in-waiting.

sentences.zh: 時宣司兵戍襄陽，都統趙淳、副統制魏友諒與統制呂渭孫不相下，渭孫死之，叔似遂自劾委任失當。

translations.literal: At the time pacification commission troops garrisoned Xiangyang; commander-in-chief Zhao Chun, deputy commander Wei Youliang, and regimental commander Lü Weisun were mutually defiant—Weisun died in the strife, and Shusi then impeached himself for improper appointments.
translations.idiomatic: At the time pacification commission troops garrisoned Xiangyang; commander-in-chief Zhao Chun, deputy commander Wei Youliang, and regimental commander Lü Weisun were mutually defiant—Weisun died in the strife, and Shusi then impeached himself for improper appointments.

sentences.zh: 叔似夙以功業自期，逮臨事，絕無可稱。

translations.literal: Shusi had long expected great achievements for himself, but when it came to action, there was nothing to speak of.
translations.idiomatic: Shusi had long expected great achievements for himself, but when it came to action, there was nothing to speak of.

sentences.zh: 以御史王益祥論，奪職罷祠。

translations.literal: On a memorial by censor Wang Yixiang, his post was stripped and his temple appointment revoked.
translations.idiomatic: On a memorial by censor Wang Yixiang, his post was stripped and his temple appointment revoked.

sentences.zh: 侂胄誅，諫官葉時再論，降兩官，謫福州，以兵端之開，叔似迎合故也。

translations.literal: When Tuozhou was executed, remonstrance officer Ye Shi memorialized again—Shusi was demoted two ranks and banished to Fuzhou, because he had gone along with the opening of hostilities.
translations.idiomatic: When Tuozhou was executed, remonstrance officer Ye Shi memorialized again—Shusi was demoted two ranks and banished to Fuzhou, because he had gone along with the opening of hostilities.

sentences.zh: 久之，許自便。

translations.literal: After a long time, he was permitted to return at his convenience.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time, he was permitted to return at his convenience.

sentences.zh: 嘉定十四年卒，贈銀青光祿大夫，謚「恭翼」。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Jiading he died; he was posthumously granted Silver-Gleaming Grand Master of Glorious Blessing, with the posthumous title "Respectful and Winged."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of Jiading he died; he was posthumously granted Silver-Gleaming Grand Master of Glorious Blessing, with the posthumous title "Respectful and Winged."

sentences.zh: 叔似雅慕朱熹，窮道德性命之旨，談天文、地理、鐘律、象數之學，有稿二十卷。

translations.literal: Shusi greatly admired Zhu Xi, exhaustively pursued the principles of moral nature and destiny, and discussed astronomy, geography, pitch pipes, and numerology—he left twenty scrolls of drafts.
translations.idiomatic: Shusi greatly admired Zhu Xi, exhaustively pursued the principles of moral nature and destiny, and discussed astronomy, geography, pitch pipes, and numerology—he left twenty scrolls of drafts.

sentences.zh: 劉甲，字師文，其先永靜軍東光人，元祐宰相摯之後也。

translations.literal: Liu Jia, styled Shiwen, his ancestors were from Dongguang in Yongjing Army, a descendant of Zhi, prime minister of the Yuanyou era.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jia, whose style name was Shiwen, came from Dongguang in Yongjing Army; his family were descendants of Zhi, the prime minister of the Yuanyou era.

sentences.zh: 父著，為成都漕幕，葬龍遊，因家焉。

translations.literal: His father Zhu served on the staff of the Chengdu transport commissioner, was buried at Longyou, and the family settled there.
translations.idiomatic: His father Zhu served on the staff of the Chengdu transport commissioner; after he was buried at Longyou, the family made their home there.

sentences.zh: 甲，淳熙二年進士，累官至度支郎中，遷樞密院檢詳兼國史院編修官、實錄院檢討官。

translations.literal: Jia, a jinshi of the second year of Chunxi, rose through successive offices to Director in the Bureau of Revenue, was transferred to Detailed Examiner at the Bureau of Military Affairs while also serving as Compiler at the National History Office and Reviewing Editor at the Veritable Records Office.
translations.idiomatic: Jia passed the jinshi examination in the second year of the Chunxi reign and eventually rose to Director in the Bureau of Revenue; he was then transferred to Detailed Examiner at the Bureau of Military Affairs, concurrently serving as Compiler at the National History Office and Reviewing Editor at the Veritable Records Office.

sentences.zh: 使金，至燕山，伴宴完顏者，名犯仁廟嫌諱，甲力辭，完顏更名修。
